relationalExpectations: K1 creates one result-owning root-child accounting program.
K2 creates one independent root-child accounting program rather than nesting under K1 merely because it depends on the K1 result.
K3 refreshes the exact K2 program and result IDs, appends evidence and provenance, and creates no program or result.
Every transition is bound to the exact old knowledge state, old live W+ state, accepted-claim digest, current evidence manifest, semantic packet, and reducer-derived local authoring scope.
Only root and explicitly changed local programs are reassessed; all other W+ primitives are carried forward unchanged and R, C, and W remain trusted derived fields.
